subject: Private Offer: SKU packaging, evidence and reseller margin clarifications
messages:
From: Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@nimblehealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@nimblehealth.com>
Date: 2025-06-29T14:08:00Z
Subject: Private offer – SKU packaging & channel margin evidence request

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement is preparing the internal approval packet for the AWS private offer (NIM-4729) and we need a couple of clarifications so we can finalize the financials:

1) SKU packaging: can you confirm the exact line items that will appear on the invoice for the private offer? We need a mapping (SKU -> description -> unit price -> billing cadence).

2) Reseller margin calculation: our channel team asks whether partner/reseller margin is calculated on Redwood's list price or on net after marketplace credits / early adopter credits. This matters for our commission and cost-of-goods accounting.

3) Evidence for auditors: could you provide a short workback that shows how the margin is derived (example calculation) and any supporting docs you normally provide to procurement (e.g., a one-page margin summary and a line-item export)?

4) Timing: we plan an internal pricing review on Monday (US PT). If possible, can we get the docs by EOD today or first thing Monday?

Appreciate the fast turn. If easier, loop in whoever owns marketplace invoicing.

Regards,
Carlos Ruiz
Senior Procurement Manager
NimbleHealth
procurement@nimblehealth.com

---
Attachments: (none)
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-06-29T16:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Private offer – SKU packaging & channel margin evidence request

Hi Carlos —

Thanks for the clear list. Short answers below, and I've attached a preliminary line-item workbook for the AWS private offer. Ben, copying you for the definitive margin workback and to confirm our pass-through behavior. Vanessa, flagging for any partner-ops notes.

Quick responses:
- SKU packaging: attached workbook (privoffer_lineitem_breakdown.xlsx) contains SKU codes we will include on the PO/invoice and suggested descriptions. The private offer will be billed monthly for metered usage, and any reserved capacity line items will be billed monthly as a recurring charge.

- Reseller margin: Redwood's standard practice is to calculate reseller commission on the list price visible in the private offer. However, marketplace-specific credits (e.g., Marketplace Service Fee credits) are accounted for separately and do not reduce the list-price basis for partner commission by default. There are exceptions for bespoke reseller arrangements — Ben, can you confirm if we need to treat NimbleHealth differently?

- Evidence: the attached workbook includes an illustrative calculation tab (row-level) and a summary tab. I'll also attach a short PDF margin workback once Ben completes it.

Next steps: Ben, can you finalize the margin PDF and confirm whether the commission should be treated on list vs net for this deal? Carlos — if you need us to redact any pricing columns for internal distribution, let us know and we can provide a sanitized copy.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0123

Attachments: privoffer_lineitem_breakdown.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 sheet with summary + calculations)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@nimblehealth.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-06-30T02:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Private offer – SKU packaging & channel margin evidence request

Carlos / Grace —

I've attached the reseller margin workback PDF (reseller_margin_workback.pdf) and pasted the key points below so procurement has a short summary for auditors.

Executive summary:
- Basis for commission: list price in the private offer (i.e., pre-marketplace credits) = commissionable base.
- Marketplace credits (any AWS promotional/marketing credits) are treated as a contra-revenue adjustment post-invoice and do not reduce the commissionable base unless explicitly agreed in the contract.
- Pass-through items (taxes, third-party transit) are excluded from the commission calculation.

Illustrative workback (simplified):
- SKU A (reserved GPU pool): List price $10,000/mo -> Reseller margin 12% -> Reseller credit $1,200/mo
- SKU B (metered inference): Estimated list price $4,000/mo -> Reseller margin 12% -> Reseller credit $480/mo
- Total list price: $14,000/mo -> Reseller credit = $1,680/mo

Notes:
- If NimbleHealth requires margin to be calculated on net after our special early-adopter credit (we offer a temporary credit in Q3), that is a contractual exception. We can model the effect (example attached).
- For audit evidence, the PDF includes the math, the mapping between SKU codes in the workbook and invoice line items, and a time-stamped sample invoice export format we provide to customers.

Operational items for NimbleHealth:
1) Confirm whether your channel agreement requires commissionable base = net after credits. If yes, call this out and we'll produce a redline to the reseller addendum.
2) Confirm the list of reseller entities that should receive the credit (one entity vs multiple sub-distributors).
3) Let us know whether you want the workback redacted for wider distribution.

I'm happy to jump on a 20-min call to walk procurement through the spreadsheet and PDF. Grace — happy to own the call if we schedule it.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Director, Partner Economics
Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
+1 650-555-0234

Attachments: reseller_margin_workback.pdf (2 pages: summary + example calculations)
